section: Conditional Courses of Action and Their Dependencies

table.caption: Three conditional paths in the fictional crisis. These are decision branches, not validated recommendations; each depends on facts or sovereign choices the brief does not settle.
rows: Occupancy remains safe long enough for care and an observed pause.
